blocks.heading: Things to do in Puntarenas
blocks.text: Puntarenas is Costa Rica’s Pacific gateway — tropical shoreline, rainforest in the background and coffee fields climbing uphill to the central valley. You’ll find bold biodiversity, artisan villages and a laid‑back coastal culture all jammed into every day. Whether you’re exploring far and wide or just stepping off the ship, expect sweat, smiles and serious scenery.

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Puntarenas
blocks.text: If you’re looking for things to do in and around Puntarenas, these tours bring the rainforest, coast and culture out of the brochure and straight onto your itinerary. Pick your pace and let the Pacific play host.

blocks.heading: Eco‑Jungle River Cruise & Butterfly Gardens
blocks.text: A motorcoach takes you to the banks of the Tárcoles River and the Guacalillo Estuary, where a covered boat glides you past crocodiles, kingfishers and macaws. Afterwards you’ll visit a butterfly garden and snack on fruit and coffee amidst rainforest calm before returning to port. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Rainforest Canopy Zip line & Aerial Tram Combination
blocks.text: You’ll ride from port into a private reserve, soar above the treetops on an aerial tram and then whizz down nine zipline cables — the longest is nearly 720 feet — while the Pacific stretches into the horizon. After a Costa Rican lunch, you’ll ride back with your adrenaline in check and heart still up in the clouds. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Starbucks Coffee Tour & Oxcart Factory
blocks.text: Journey inland to Hacienda Alsacia, where you’ll track a coffee bean from nursery to espresso in a tasting session. Then head to Sarchí to witness artisans hand‑paint massive oxcarts. Shop their work and load your camera with local colour before the return drive to port. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Puntarenas: Aerial Tram, Tarcoles River & Lunch
blocks.text: This full‑day adventure combines a gondola ride through Rainforest Adventures Eco‑Park, a riverside cruise of the Tarcoles with crocodiles and mangroves and a hearty Costa Rican‑style lunch. Comfortable shoes are recommended and so is a quick eye for pictures. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Andalusian Horse Show & Countryside
blocks.text: Hop aboard and wind through fields of mango and watermelon en route to Rancho San Miguel. There you’ll experience an equestrian performance of dressage and flamenco rhythms featuring pure‑bred Andalusian horses and large‑scale cultural flair. Finish with a brief souvenir stop and fresh coffee before heading back to your ship. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Sloth Sanctuary, Botanical Garden, Oxcart Factory & Lunch
blocks.text: You’ll start at the Costa Rica Animal Rescue Center to meet sloths and monkeys, then move on to La Garita’s botanical gardens and end in Sarchí where the iconic oxcarts are still handcrafted. Lunch is served along the way — animals, nature, culture and cuisine in one energetic loop. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Cruises to Isla Tropicale, Roatan, Honduras
Things to do in Roatan
blocks.text: Snorkel or dive among coral reefs at Roatan Marine Park, soak up the sun on the powdery white sands of West Bay Beach, or explore tropical gardens and exotic wildlife at Gumbalimba Park. As you stroll through Isla Tropicale, you can enjoy the shopping, dining and water activities that await. You can also indulge in Caribbean flavors, from fresh seafood to the island’s famous coconut bread.

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore Roatan
blocks.text: Make the most of your time in Roatan with Princess excursions designed to showcase the local culture and tropical beaches.

blocks.heading: Maya Key Private Island, Animal Sanctuary & Lunch
blocks.text: Live the Caribbean dream when you visit Maya Key, an 11.5-acre private island that embraces the breathtaking country of Honduras. Your adventure begins with a scenic boat ride to this tropical paradise conveniently located just three minutes across the bay from the pier. VIEW EXCURSIONS

blocks.heading: West Bay beach on your own
blocks.text: Spend the day at one of Roatan’s most stunning beaches, where crystal-clear waters and soft white sand make for the perfect tropical escape. Lounge in the sun or snorkel among colorful reefs — and top it all off with a refreshing cocktail by the shore. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Cultural show, scenic drive & shopping

blocks.heading: Best of Roatán: Gumbalimba Preservation nature park & scenic rrive

blocks.heading: Botanical Gardens, Birds, Butterflies & West End Village
blocks.text: Celebrate the natural beauty and cultural wonders of Roatan on a guided tour. Board your air-conditioned transportation at the pier for a beautiful scenic drive to the Blue Harbor Tropical Arboretum, which feature 160 acres of ferns, spices, and other tropical plants. A naturalist guides your exploration of the grounds. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Things to do in San Juan
Shore excursions to explore in San Juan
blocks.text: San Juan’s shore excursions highlight its centuries-old forts, lush rainforest, colorful neighborhoods and white-sand beaches. Each experience reveals a unique side of Puerto Rico’s history and natural beauty.

blocks.heading: History & Cuisine of San Juan on Foot
blocks.text: Take a guided walking tour through historic Old San Juan, stopping at key landmarks and learning about the city’s 500-year-old past. Along the way, enjoy tastings of Puerto Rican favorites like mofongo and local coffee. It’s the perfect blend of culture, storytelling and culinary discovery—all in one flavorful afternoon. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of San Juan: Old and New San Juan City Tour & Shopping
blocks.text: Discover the vibrant contrasts of Puerto Rico’s capital on a panoramic driving tour through modern San Juan and a walking journey through the cobblestone streets of Old San Juan. Explore Spanish colonial architecture, snap photos at historic sites and enjoy time for shopping at quaint boutiques or open-air markets packed with local flavor and culture. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Old San Juan Fortresses & Shopping
blocks.text: Step back in time as you visit the island’s most iconic Spanish fortresses, El Morro and San Cristobal, both UNESCO World Heritage Sites. Hear tales of pirates, battles and Spanish colonial rule, then enjoy some leisure time to shop for local crafts, jewelry, or souvenirs in charming Old San Juan. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: El Yunque National Rainforest Scenic Drive
blocks.text: Journey into the lush heart of El Yunque, the only tropical rainforest in the U.S. National Forest System. This guided drive reveals stunning views of waterfalls, dense foliage and tropical wildlife. Enjoy informative stops and photo opportunities along the way, immersing yourself in Puerto Rico’s breathtaking natural beauty. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Puerto Rico’s Favorites
blocks.text: Experience the island’s top highlights on this well-rounded tour that includes panoramic city views, a stop at the famed Bacardi Distillery Visitor Center and time in colorful Old San Juan. Learn about Puerto Rico’s rum-making heritage, soak in rich colonial history and enjoy time to explore or shop in this unforgettable Caribbean capital. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Beach Escape at Vivo Beach Club
blocks.text: Relax and unwind at Vivo Beach Club, a modern beachfront oasis offering pristine sand, turquoise water and stylish amenities. Lounge by the pool, swim in the ocean, or grab a tropical drink at the bar. With a lively atmosphere and oceanfront views, this is your perfect beach day in San Juan. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Things to do in St. Kitts
blocks.text: St. Kitts is an island of contrasts—wild volcanic peaks give way to sun-drenched beaches, while colonial-era landmarks stand alongside lush rainforests. If adventure calls, hike through dense jungle to the summit of Mount Liamuiga, where misty crater views make the climb worthwhile. Prefer something more leisurely? Sail to the nearby island of Nevis, where quiet beaches and historic sites set a sl

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore St. Kitts
Local Connections: Romney Manor, Caribelle Batik & Timothy Hill Lookout with Artist
blocks.text: Ideal for those who wish to see the sights with little or no walking, this tour around Basseterre is a great way to get acquainted with the beauty and history of St. Kitts. As you drive through town, your driver will point out landmarks like Independence Square, St. George's Anglican Church, the Berkeley Memorial, and the Queen Victoria Statue Roundabout. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Brimstone Hill Fortress
blocks.text: Nicknamed the "Gibraltar of the West Indies," this 17th-century fortress offers some of the most spectacular views in the Caribbean. During your Best of St. Kitts, Brimstone Hill excursion, walk through its stone archways and climb to the top for a sweeping panorama of St. Kitts’ coastline and neighboring islands. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Cockleshell Beach
blocks.text: Where soft sand meets gentle waves, the Cockleshell Beach excursion is a favorite for those looking to soak up the Caribbean sun. Lounge under an umbrella, sip a cool drink from a beachside bar or wade into the inviting waters with a view of Nevis in the distance. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Coastal Kayaking and Snorkeling
blocks.text: Paddle along the island’s scenic southeast coast on the Coastal Kayaking and Snorkeling excursion, where hidden coves and rugged cliffs make for an unforgettable adventure. Glide through the waves before diving into crystal-clear waters, where parrotfish, angelfish and vibrant coral formations wait just below the surface. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Scenic Railway Ride
blocks.text: Board a double-decker railcar and wind through the lush countryside, taking in sugarcane fields, coastal cliffs and charming villages along the way. With open-air seating on the upper level of this Scenic Railway Ride excursion, this one-of-a-kind railway tour offers unbeatable 360-degree views. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Things to do in St Lucia
blocks.text: Emerald mountains and steaming volcanic springs are just the beginning of St. Lucia’s best wonders. Taste the island’s unique Creole and Caribbean cuisine, from fresh seafood and jerk chicken to the famous green fig and saltfish. Take to the treetops on a Rainforest Zipline Adventure for a high-flying look at the jungle below. Beneath the waves, snorkeling at Anse Chastanet reveals a kaleidoscope

blocks.heading: Top attractions and shore excursions in St. Lucia
Volcanic Island Experience & Mud Bath
blocks.text: Discover the beauty and nature of St. Lucia with an adventure that begins with a leisurely sightseeing tour around the Island's West coast and ends with an invigorating volcanic bath (and an outdoor shower). Your scenic drive from the pier takes you through two traditional fishing villages and skirts the fringes of the rainforest. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: The Pitons
blocks.text: St. Lucia’s most famous landmarks, Gros Piton and Petit Piton, stand like ancient guardians over the island’s western coast. These UNESCO-listed volcanic peaks are a must-see, whether you're admiring The Pitons from the deck of a catamaran or hiking their rugged trails during an excursion with Princess. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Castries Market
blocks.text: There’s no better way to visit St. Lucia’s capital than on our Castries by Trolley Train excursion. Bustling, colorful and brimming with local flavor, Castries Market is the place to find handcrafted souvenirs, fresh tropical fruit and the island’s famous spiced rum. The scents of cinnamon, nutmeg and sizzling street food fill the air as vendors call out their daily specials. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Marigot Bay
blocks.text: Framed by emerald hills and dotted with sleek sailboats, Marigot Bay is pure Caribbean charm. Relax at a waterfront café, take a leisurely boat ride through the mangroves or simply soak in the view—we make it easy to visit with our Marigot Bay excursion. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Snorkel & Scenic Coastal Cruise
blocks.text: Under-the-sea splendors await on this snorkel adventure. Departing from your ship, you'll board your snorkeling vessel and cruise the island's West coast with views of the coastline and bays. You'll have ample photo opportunities, and your crew will point out highlights. Once at the snorkel site, you'll receive a safety orientation. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Warm Mineral Baths & Garden Tour
blocks.text: Stroll along the island's oldest Botanical Garden, and be refreshed in the warm therapeutic mineral baths built in 1700's by one of the famous French General. Your knowledgeable guide will highlight all of the island's historical, natural and cultural uniqueness as you travel along. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Things to do in St. Maarten
blocks.text: Legend has it that a Dutchman and a Frenchman did a walking competition to divide this island in half. Today, that means you can explore a unique combination of these two cultures — with a Caribbean twist — and visit both capital cities. Ride a horse along the stunning Caribbean beaches or spend the day kayaking through the lagoons. And don’t miss the delightful Little Bay Beach: a small, quiet re

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore St. Maarten
blocks.text: From colorful seaside cities to a one-of-a-kind French and Dutch culture, St. Maarten is an unforgettable Caribbean destination. Here are some of the activities you can do when you sail here with Princess:

blocks.heading: Sky Explorer, Schooner Ride & Canopy Tour
blocks.text: Ready for a burst of adrenaline and breathtaking views? Ride the Sentry Hill Zip Line over the lush green mountainside for 360-degree views of St. Maarten and neighboring islands. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of St. Maarten
blocks.text: Explore both the French and Dutch capitals on both sides of the island and see how these European cities look with a little Caribbean flair. Bite into warm croissants at an open-air market and get panoramic views of the island at St. Barth. And don’t worry: no tour of St. Maarten is complete with a stop at Maho Beach where planes will land a mere stone’s throw away from you. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Trail & Beach Horseback Ride & Scenic Drive
blocks.text: Giddy up! See the stunning natural scenery of the island from the back of a horse — and even ride your horse into the shallows of the turquoise ocean. Your horses will carry you up rocky hills to see the local cacti and through the local flora and fauna. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Golden Eagle Catamaran Sail, Snorkel & Beach Break
blocks.text: All aboard this 80-foot Catamaran where you can spend the day relaxing on deck and soaking in the views of St. Maarten. If you’re feeling adventurous, hop off the boat and spend time snorkeling to see if you can spot colorful arrays of fish or even a sea turtle. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Lagoon Kayaking Adventure
blocks.text: Kayak through Simpson Bay Lagoon, the largest saltwater lagoon in the northeastern Caribbean where you can see the local flora and fauna and learn all about the ecosystem from your expert guide. You’ll also pass through the high-end marinas that are filled with luxury yachts from November through April. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Experience the St. Maarten port on your next cruise
blocks.text: Eastern Caribbean Cruises offer convenient departures with St. Maarten as a highlight, while Southern Caribbean Voyages let you explore St. Maarten alongside other exotic island destinations, and for those seeking more extensive exploration, Caribbean Adventures feature longer itineraries of 10 days or more that span multiple regions of the Caribbean.

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore Turks and Caicos
blocks.text: Embark on Princess Cruises' exclusive Turks and Caicos shore excursions, where every adventure is thoughtfully crafted to showcase the islands' most captivating experiences. From the scenic Rainbow Calypso Tram journey through historic Cockburn Town to hands-on conch preparation with local chefs and serene adults-only beach retreats, each excursion offers something special for every traveler. With

blocks.heading: Panoramas & Painting
blocks.text: Capture the island’s beauty with Panoramas & Painting, a one-of-a-kind experience where you’ll create your own masterpiece under the guidance of a local artist. With Grand Turk’s stunning coastal landscapes as your inspiration, every brushstroke brings a piece of the Caribbean to life. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: The Rainbow Calypso Tram
blocks.text: Hop aboard The Rainbow Calypso Tram for a breezy ride through Grand Turk’s past and present. This open-air tram winds through Cockburn Town, past historic salt ponds and colonial-era landmarks that create a laid-back way to take in the island’s charm. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Local Conch Recipes, Sightseeing, Beach & Lunch
blocks.text: Turks and Caicos is famous for its conch, and there’s no better way to experience it than on the Local Conch Recipes, Sightseeing, Beach & Lunch excursion. Watch as skilled locals prepare this island delicacy, then taste it fresh alongside a beachside meal with stunning ocean views. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Adults-Only Beach House Retreat
blocks.text: For those seeking total relaxation, the Adults-Only Beach House Retreat offers a peaceful escape on a secluded stretch of sand. Sink into a shaded cabana, sip a tropical cocktail and let the gentle waves set the pace of your day. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Jeep Adventure & Beach
blocks.text: Venture off the beaten path on a Jeep Adventure & Beach tour, where rugged trails lead to some of Grand Turk’s most stunning hidden spots. After an off-road ride past windswept cliffs and panoramic coastal views, cool off with a dip in the turquoise waters of a quiet island beach. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Experience the Turks and Caicos your next cruise
blocks.text: Visit Grand Turk port on your Caribbean cruise to see how historical sights line the streets and adventure awaits along every coast. Longer combination itineraries let you experience even more of the Eastern and Southern Caribbean with a memorable stop in Grand Turk. blocks.heading: What will you do on an Eastern Caribbean cruise?
blocks.text: There’s no right way to pass the days in the Eastern Caribbean.

blocks.heading: Old-world charm
blocks.text: The Eastern Caribbean is a treasure trove of old-world charm, blending colonial history with enchanting landscapes. Wander through the narrow streets of Old San Juan, Puerto Rico, where pastel-colored buildings and imposing fortresses tell tales of the past. Visit the historic sites of Philipsburg in St. Maarten, or explore the serene beauty of Princess Cays with its quaint beachfront and rustic a

blocks.heading: Breathtaking beaches
blocks.text: The Eastern Caribbean is renowned for its pristine, sun-kissed beaches, offering crystal-clear waters and powdery white sands that stretch as far as the eye can see. From the famous Maho Beach in St. Maarten, where planes soar overhead, to the secluded shores of Trunk Bay in the Virgin Islands, each beach promises a unique and unforgettable experience. Whether you’re looking to relax under swaying

blocks.heading: Local culture
blocks.text: Immerse yourself in the rich and diverse cultures of the Eastern Caribbean, where each island offers a unique tapestry of traditions, music and cuisine. Explore the lively markets of San Juan, Puerto Rico, where you can savor local delicacies like mofongo and listen to the rhythmic beats of salsa and reggaeton. Discover the historic charm of Charlotte Amalie in St. Thomas, with its cobblestone str

blocks.heading: Magens Bay, St. Thomas
blocks.text: One of the top 10 beaches in the world according to National Geographic magazine, Magens Bay, is known for its picturesque beauty and deep, sheltered bay with calm waters. With gentle waves rolling onto a white sand beach that stretches three quarters of a mile, Magens Bay is your place to relax, swim and explore with ease.

blocks.heading: Trunk Bay, St. John
blocks.text: Named one of Condé Nast Traveler's Seven Cruise Wonders of the World, Trunk Bay is stunning beyond words. Snorkel along an underwater coral reef trail, swim through warm clear waters, and lounge on the white sands while looking out on a vista that can only be described as tropical perfection.

blocks.heading: Orient Beach & Little Bay Beach, St. Maarten
blocks.text: Two beaches, both with soft sand, warm water and refreshing breezes, make for the perfect day by the ocean. Snorkel with sea life, paddle through the azure waters, or relax on the beach.

blocks.heading: Caribbean cruise onboard experience featured program
blocks.text: Award-winning programs. World-class chefs. And Caribbean-themed activities, day and night. With Princess, your ship is a destination all its own.

blocks.heading: Deeper experiences of the islands
blocks.text: Discover the history of local distilleries while sampling some of the region’s best rums, meet the parrots and macaws that call the Caribbean home in the ship's Piazza, or sink into the rhythms of the region with steel pan drum lessons. Our onboard activities give you the chance to gain a deeper connection and understanding to islands you'll visit on your voyage.

blocks.heading: Comfortable accommodations
blocks.text: Your stateroom is your home away from home where you can rest up and recharge between adventures. With the expertly designed Princess Luxury Bed, luxurious 100% Jacquard-woven cotton linens and our SLEEP program, specially created by a board-certified sleep expert, you might just get the best sleep of your life. We offer staterooms ranging from interior cabins to full suites, and we even offer con

blocks.heading: Bringing local life aboard
blocks.text: Embrace the spirit of the islands the moment you step on your ship with our Rhythm of the Caribbean program. Savor island cuisine, sip signature cocktails and engage in authentic regional experiences. Dance beneath the stars to vibrant island rhythms at exclusive parties, and immerse yourself in one-of-a-kind cultural activities — from concerts and crafts to talks from shark experts and treasure h

blocks.heading: Never miss a beat
blocks.text: Say goodbye to the daily grind with our new Sail Away Party poolside on the top deck, dance to local music at one of the many Caribbean inspired concerts, or be the envy of every pirate at our high-energy gold treasure-inspired Terrace Pool Gold Party. Throughout your Caribbean cruise there will be events that invite you to fully experience the islands.

blocks.heading: Things to do in Princess Cays
blocks.text: Princess Cays is located on the southern tip of Eleuthera, one of the islands in the Bahamas. This private cruise destination sits along a beautiful stretch of coastline known for its white-sand beaches and clear turquoise waters, offering a secluded and scenic stop in the Caribbean. At this exclusive Princess-owned island only for Princess guests, enjoy the stunning Bahamas paradise by kayaking a

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore Princess Cays
blocks.text: Beautiful sea coral, swaying palm trees, private cabanas and more. Princess Cays is a quiet, private island experience exclusively for Princess guests, where you can spend the day on the soft white sand beach soaking in some rays and enjoying a Caribbean paradise — or dive beneath the waves for an underwater adventure where you’ll see a rainbow of fish and coral. Looking for a little retail therap

blocks.heading: Surf Fishing
blocks.text: Spend a couple of hours with a fishing rod in your hand overlooking the blue Caribbean Sea. Try your luck at surf fishing off a stretch of Princess Cays' rocky shoreline. Our all-inclusive package includes, rod and reel, bait (squid), aqua shoes, and expert Bahamian fishermen to assist if requested. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Glass-Bottom Boat Cruise
blocks.text: Explore the underwater world of the Bahamas without getting wet! Board a state-of-the-art glass-bottom boat and look below at the stunning and colorful coral reef. You’ll be able to see a rainbow of fish and the coral and sponges that call these waters home. There are fish identification cards on board, so you can challenge yourself to try and figure out what every fish you see is. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Snorkeling at Princess Cays
blocks.text: See what’s under the deep azure waters surrounding this private island resort on a snorkeling adventure with Princess. Experienced snorkelers will love the colorful coral formations, gorgonians (soft coral-like sea fans) and sea sponges that make this spot such an underwater paradise. Keep your eyes peeled for schools of fish and even the occasional dolphin or sea turtle. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Ocean Kayak Rental
blocks.text: See all of Princess Cays from the comfort of your own kayak. There’s no better way to see the crystal-clear beachfront waters of Princess Cays than by being out on the water and looking down at the colorful fish. You’ll love the untouched beauty of Eleuthera’s coastline as you explore this exclusive island. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Exclusive Adults-Only Bungalow Rental
blocks.text: Looking for a little R&R? Rent a private bungalow on Princess’s private beach to have somewhere to relax and enjoy the peace and serenity of the Caribbean paradise you’re in. You’ll have a ceiling fan to keep cool, furniture to relax and enjoy a picnic, a private open-air shower and staff members to take drink orders. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Find your own rhythm in the Caribbean
Make your time ashore a story worth telling
blocks.text: In the Caribbean, some of the best stories unfold when you settle into the rhythm of the islands. Snorkel clear blue waters, wander colorful local markets, taste something made just down the road or simply find your place in the shade. With thoughtfully curated excursions and trusted local guides, Princess makes it easy to experience each destination in a way that feels personal — and come back wi

blocks.heading: Historic landmarks
blocks.text: From the birthplace of Alexander Hamilton on St. Kitt's sister island of Nevis to Nelson's Harbor on Antigua that sheltered the mighty British fleet during the Napoleonic Wars, the Caribbean is brimming with history and steeped in stories. Learn the history of the Hato Caves on Curacao or tour the Dutch-inspired classical architecture in the capital of Willemstad.

blocks.heading: Swim with stingrays
blocks.text: Swim with hundreds of stingrays in their natural habitat on Grand Cayman. Pods of stingrays, called a fever, come to the island to have and raise their young, and this Caribbean cruise excursion is one you'll never forget as you swim among these gentle creatures.

blocks.heading: Explore ancient ruins
blocks.text: Ancient Mayan ruins scatter the beautiful island of Cozumel, once thought to be the home of the moon goddess Ixchel. On this Caribbean cruise excursion you will explore temples, palaces and more, and feel yourself walking in the footsteps of the ancient peoples who once lived in those very spots.

blocks.heading: Swimming & snorkeling
blocks.text: Dive into the blue, endless depths of the Scotts Head Marine Reserve bay on the island of Dominica, formed from the caldera of an ancient, now dormant, volcano submerged beneath the Caribbean Sea. Untouched coral reefs, dramatic underwater formations and hundreds of species of marine life await you on this Caribbean cruise excursion which is also a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

blocks.heading: River tubing
blocks.text: Relax on an inner tube in Belize as the soft current takes you through dense rainforests, ancient caves and nearly-lost Mayan ruins once used to worship many of their gods. Guides teach you the names of the local wildlife, cave structures and ancient ruins as you pass by on this relaxing Caribbean cruise excursion.

blocks.heading: Ziplining excursions
blocks.text: Climb thousands of feet in an open-air tram on the island of St. Lucia until you reach the pulse-pounding zipline course. Embark on a journey that spans the rainforest canopy over one hundred feet above the forest floor and highlights the awe-inspiring vistas and unique wildlife of the island.

blocks.heading: Scenic cruising excursions
blocks.text: Some of the most beautiful coastline in the world is on the island of St. Kitts, with azure waters, dramatic cliffs, coral reefs and soft white beaches. One of the best ways to see every last postcard-perfect foot of the island is from the deck of an expertly piloted catamaran, with a stop for some reef snorkeling of course.

blocks.heading: Outdoor adventure
blocks.text: Bonaire's arid interior, home to salt-drying flats for hundreds of years, make for the perfect 4x4 terrain. Take your rugged vehicle across the wild interior of the island, and see the most famous sights, mountains of salt, Caribbean flamingos and iguanas living in the mangrove forests.

blocks.heading: Two private beaches waiting just for you
blocks.text: Leave the ordinary behind and immerse yourself in the pure perfection of Celebration Key and Half Moon Cay.

blocks.heading: Local Connections: Wildlife sanctuary, kayak, hike & snorkel with Marine Biologist
blocks.text: Kayak, snorkel, hike and explore at the Mangrove Lagoon Wildlife Sanctuary and Marine Preserve in St. Thomas. This half-day, multi-eco experience includes complimentary snacks and beverages. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Rainforest canopy zipline adventure
blocks.text: Soar through the treetops of Antigua's rainforest on an exhilarating zipline adventure. This eco-tour puts you in the heart of the forest and carries you over spectacular scenery and a dramatic gorge. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Butterfly farm, rock formations & shopping
blocks.text: Tour Aruba’s fascinating Butterfly Farm to learn more about these delicate insects. Then, pay a visit to the island’s famous aloe factory before a stop at the breathtaking Casibari rock formation. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Atlantis submarine scenic adventure
blocks.text: Dive to the bottom of Barbados without getting wet! Board the Atlantis submarine and descend up to 150 feet. Marvel at a breathtaking mysterious sunken shipwreck and marine life like barracudas, eels and stingrays through the large, photo-friendly portholes. After you resurface, receive a dive certificate to commemorate your underwater adventure. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Caye Caulker shark & ray encounter
blocks.text: Jump into the aquamarine waters of Caye Caulker and snorkel with tropical fish and barracuda. Then, get ready to make unforgettable memories as you swim with nurse sharks and southern stingrays at Shark Ray Alley. Enjoy free time to explore the island and a rum punch on the return trip. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Dolphin swim & Blue Lagoon Beach fun with lunch
blocks.text: Say hello to some fine, flippered friends on a thrilling Dolphin Swim experience in Nassau that includes personal interaction with these gentle mammals and the opportunity to swim alongside them. Then, enjoy fun and sun on Blue Lagoon Beach, a beautiful stretch of white sand with crystal-clear waters. Includes a buffet lunch. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Scenic railway ride & coastal cruise
blocks.text: Sightsee by land and sea in St. Kitts. Hop aboard a historic train for a unique island view. Then, board a catamaran and sail along the coast past Brimstone Hill, the green slopes of Mount Liamuiga, Old Road, and Bloody Point, where the French and British joined to defeat the Carib Indians in 1626. blocks.text: See what adventures await you off the beaten path, whether it’s exploring a Dutch-style city or kayaking through a mangrove forest.

blocks.heading: Mambo Beach, Willemstad, Curaçao
blocks.text: Grab a lounger and relax on the soft white sands, rent snorkel equipment and swim through the pristine blue waters observing magnificent sea life, or grab a snack at the many eateries on the boardwalk as you indulge in some luxurious shopping.

blocks.heading: Eagle Beach, Aruba
blocks.text: Perfection might be the best word to describe the picturesque Eagle Beach. Aruba cruises offer soft white sand, shimmering turquoise water and a quiet atmosphere making relaxation easy. Take in the surroundings from a lounge chair, swim the calm warm waters and enjoy local cuisine right near the beach.

blocks.heading: Kenepa Beach, Curaçao
blocks.text: A picturesque beach, sheltered between two rock outcroppings, makes for calm azure waters and relaxing beach days. The sand is soft, white and warm and everything you could want to complement the beautiful scenery is right at your fingertips.

blocks.heading: Caribbean cruise onboard experience featured program
blocks.text: Award-winning programs. World-class chefs. And Caribbean-themed activities, day and night. With Princess, your ship is a destination all its own.

blocks.heading: Deeper experiences of the islands
blocks.text: Discover the history of local distilleries while sampling some of the region’s best rums, meet the parrots and macaws that call the Caribbean home in the ship's Piazza, or sink into the rhythms of the region with steel pan drum lessons. Our onboard activities give you the chance to gain a deeper connection and understanding to islands you'll visit on your voyage.

blocks.heading: Comfortable accommodations
blocks.text: Your stateroom is your home away from home where you can rest up and recharge between adventures. With the expertly designed Princess Luxury Bed, luxurious 100% Jacquard-woven cotton linens and our SLEEP program, specially created by a board-certified sleep expert, you might just get the best sleep of your life. We offer staterooms ranging from interior cabins to full suites, and we even offer con

blocks.heading: Bringing local life aboard
blocks.text: Embrace the spirit of the islands the moment you step on your ship with our Rhythm of the Caribbean program. Savor island cuisine, sip signature cocktails and engage in authentic regional experiences. Dance beneath the stars to vibrant island rhythms at exclusive parties, and immerse yourself in one-of-a-kind cultural activities — from concerts and crafts to talks from shark experts and treasure h

blocks.heading: Never miss a beat
blocks.text: Say goodbye to the daily grind with our new Sail Away Party poolside on the top deck, dance to local music at one of the many Caribbean inspired concerts, or be the envy of every pirate at our high-energy gold treasure-inspired Terrace Pool Gold Party. Throughout your Caribbean cruise there will be events that invite you to fully experience the islands.

blocks.heading: Ship activities for every cruise to the Caribbean
Family
blocks.text: Enjoy a ship full of activities for the whole family, from Broadway-style shows to Discovery’s Shark Week all summer long, your family will be engaged in the Caribbean. Go stargazing under the stunning expanse of the night sky, compete in a family game night and savor the flavors of the islands together.

blocks.heading: Relaxation
blocks.text: Pamper yourself in the Lotus Spa® with a massage, facial or manicure, and feel renewed. Enjoy The Sanctuary, a lounge just for adults, where you can relax with a light meal, specialty drink and al fresco massages while digging into that novel you've been looking forward to reading. If you prefer more active relaxation, we offer Zumba, yoga and tai chi classes to burn off stress and raise your hear

blocks.heading: Celebration
blocks.text: Almost 30% of all passengers who sail with us are celebrating an important milestone in their lives. Say "I do" at sea in a ceremony officiated by the captain. Arrange for an anniversary package and let us spoil you with romantic balcony dining, chocolates and more. For us, every day is a celebration.

blocks.heading: Romance
blocks.text: It's difficult to imagine something more romantic than sailing through the warm waters of the Caribbean, hopping between tropical islands and white-sand beaches from the comfortable luxury of your ship. While on board we cater to your romantic side with private dining on your balcony, whether a relaxing breakfast for two or a romantic sunset dinner, honeymoon packages for lucky newlyweds, flowers

blocks.heading: Food & drinks
blocks.text: The diverse cultural influences, local climates and history of the Caribbean combine to make one of the most exciting and unique regional cuisines in the world. From mofongo, a dish from Puerto Rico made from mashed fried plantains, pork and garlic, to the famous jerk chicken of Jamaica, we serve the Caribbean's favorite flavors to you on board. Thanks to Princess' world-class chefs you'll enjoy f

blocks.heading: Movies under the stars
blocks.text: Enjoy many of the latest movies, exciting concerts and most anticipated live sports games on a massive poolside screen. The warm Caribbean night air, fresh popcorn and comfortable lounge chair with fleece blanket make for a viewing experience. Not to mention the best theater in the world, the Caribbean Ocean with a ceiling of stars!

blocks.heading: Ocho Rios Bay Beach, Jamaica

Soft sand, crystal-clear water, plentiful loungers and ice-cold beverages. What more can you ask for when you visit Ocho Rios Bay Beach on a Jamaican cruise?

The entire beach vibrates with excitement, fun and the sounds of locals and travelers reveling in a true Caribbean atmosphere. blocks.heading: Seven Mile Beach, Grand Cayman
blocks.text: Idyllic white sands that stretch as far as the eye can see in both directions, brilliant blue water beyond that and endless opportunities for activities makes Seven Mile Beach one of the best in the world. If you enjoy bars, resorts, boutiques and restaurants (that is, when you're not drinking in the stunning scenery), then you must visit Seven Mile Beach on your Grand Cayman cruise!

blocks.heading: Explore unique ports with Princess Cruises
Ravenna
blocks.text: Once the capital of the Western Roman Empire and later the seat of Byzantine rule in Italy, Ravenna is a city whose walls tell centuries of history in dazzling color. Now recognized by UNESCO for eight of its early Christian monuments, Ravenna is famed above all for its breathtaking mosaics — shimmering gold and cobalt scenes that have adorned its basilicas for over 1,500 years. On European cruise

blocks.heading: Athens
blocks.text: Rooted in Greek mythology, Athens is alive with stories from civilizations of the past. On a cruise to Europe departing from Athens, arrive early to tour the remains of ancient lores — like the Temple of Olympian Zeus and Acropolis — dine at the city’s lively tavernas and admire iconic sculptures bathed in natural light within the Acropolis Museum. Learn More

blocks.heading: Barcelona
blocks.text: Until it was popularized by the 1992 Olympics, Barcelona was a hidden gem amid Europe’s diverse landscapes. Now it’s widely recognized for its architectural masterpieces and spirited customs. On European cruises from Barcelona, leave enough time before you depart to visit Park Güell – a UNESCO World Heritage Site – and feel inspired by the colors and unique artistry that lie in the park and throug

blocks.heading: Copenhagen
blocks.text: Depart from Denmark's charming capital, known for colorful harborfront buildings, world-class design, and the iconic Little Mermaid statue. Copenhagen serves as a gateway to Scandinavia and the Baltic region's historic capitals. Learn More

blocks.heading: Istanbul
blocks.text: Begin your voyage in a city that spans two continents, where ancient history and modern life intersect along the Bosphorus. From the Hagia Sophia to bustling bazaars, Istanbul offers an unforgettable start to any Mediterranean or Black Sea cruise. Learn More

blocks.heading: London
blocks.text: From double-decker buses and telephone booths to medieval castles and monuments, experience the best of the city and countryside on a European cruise from Southampton. Ride on the London Eye and watch the Changing of the Guard at Buckingham Palace. Then head west and walk the hallways of Windsor Castle or travel even further to learn about the mystery of Stonehenge. Learn More

blocks.heading: Naples
blocks.text: Depart from this vibrant southern Italian city, set against the dramatic backdrop of Mount Vesuvius and steps from ancient Pompeii. Naples combines authentic Italian culture, incredible cuisine, and easy access to the stunning Amalfi Coast. Learn More

blocks.heading: Rome
blocks.text: Italy’s capital city is something of a dream. Grand chapels and stone angels line the roads, whispering secrets of Rome’s past. On a European cruise from Rome, arrive early to toss a coin into Trevi Fountain. Legend has it, you’ll be guaranteed a return to The Eternal City. Then walk in the footsteps of Emperors at the Colosseum, and receive a blessing from the Pope at St. Peter’s Square. Learn Mo

blocks.heading: Venice
blocks.text: Venice, the "City of Canals," is a captivating blend of history, romance and stunning architecture. Its maze-like waterways, adorned with iconic landmarks like St. Mark's Basilica, offer a unique and enchanting experience. From gondola rides along the canals to the artistry of Murano's glassmaking and the vibrant Carnival, Venice's charm lies in its rich heritage and timeless allure. Learn More

blocks.heading: Tokyo
blocks.text: Huge department stores brim with shoppers and neon flashes from dusk to dawn. From the Imperial Palace and Meiji Shrine to the famed Ginza district, Tokyo is an intriguing blend of East and West. And the amazing Mt. Fuji towers over it all. Learn More

blocks.heading: Hong Kong
blocks.text: A city where ancient temples meet modern towers, Hong Kong is a must-see in Asian travel. Set sail from this global hub and step into a world of contrasts, from the quiet serenity of incense-filled shrines to the electric energy of Victoria Harbour. Cruises from Hong Kong with Princess open the door to Asia’s most captivating coastlines, with itineraries that reach Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam and beyon

blocks.heading: Singapore
blocks.text: Small in size but not in stature, this immaculate country has some of the most pristine gardens and temples in the world and well worth a few more days to see it all. Immerse yourself in a kaleidoscope of wonders in this scintillating city. blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Athens
blocks.text: Athens is a city for thinker’s, so why not let Princess take care of the doing? We’ll handle the details and the planning, with curated shore excursions that showcase the best of Athens and its surroundings. From crumbling ruins to bustling markets, Princess takes you to the parts of Athens you won’t want to miss.

blocks.heading: Acropolis, A walk through ancient Agora and Mezes
blocks.text: Scale the heights of the Acropolis, then savor a table full of mezes that would make even Zeus jealous. Stroll the same streets that once echoed with ancient debates in the Agora. With the Stoa of Attalos as your grand finale, this tour is the real ‘Greece’ de résistance. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Ultimate Athens
blocks.text: Get ready for a history-packed day with a side of Greek wine. This excursion covers all the site-seeing Titans that make Athens special — the Acropolis, Parthenon and Olympian Zeus — plus lunch filled with old-school flavors. Cap it off with free time in Plaka’s cobbled lanes and a peek inside the stunning Acropolis Museum LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Acropolis, Plaka & Temple of Poseidon
blocks.text: ‘Ruin’ your vacation in the best way possible, by exploring the Acropolis before you even board your ship. Take in the Plaka and then cruise down the coast to Cape Sounion for an Olympus-level look at the Temple of Poseidon perched high above the Aegean sea. Add a Greek lunch, and your day can only be described as epic. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Acropolis & Rock N' Roll for Families
blocks.text: Ancient history meets electric guitar on this family-friendly adventure. Explore the Acropolis together, snap a group photo at the Old Olympic Stadium, then refuel with burgers and music memorabilia at the Hard Rock Café. It’s a day that blends rock, both old and new: marble columns with music legends, keeping every age entertained. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Uncover the history, myth and magic of Athens on your next cruise
blocks.text: See the cradle of Western civilization before setting sail on an odyssey all your own. With Athens as a major Princess Cruises® departure port, you’ll have the opportunity to explore timeless landmarks like the Acropolis and the Parthenon, wander through vibrant neighborhoods like Plaka and soak in the charm of a city where the history is as tantalizing as the cuisine. From the iconic sights to th

blocks.heading: What to know about cruises from Athens, Greece
blocks.text: Athens’ ancient success can be attributed to its prominent location along early sea-based trading routes, and that advantage continues to define the city today. With easy and direct access to both the Mediterranean and Aegean seas, cruise guests leaving from Athens have the perfect starting point to wherever their journey may take them. Here are some things to know before you get started.

pages.metaDescription: Scenic harbors and Maori culture shine on cruises from Auckland, New Zealand's vibrant "City of Sails," offering unforgettable Pacific journeys.

headings.text: Shore excursions to explore in Auckland
Best Of Auckland: City Drive & Maori Performance at Museum
Local Connections: National Maritime Museum & Harbour Cruise
Discover cruise itineraries sailing from Auckland port
Let Princess get you there with travel, airfare & hotels

blocks.heading: Things to do in Auckland
blocks.text: Cruises from Auckland kick off in a city that refuses to be ordinary — a place where volcanoes rise from parks, islands dot the harbor and black-sand beaches wait just beyond the skyline. Scale the Sky Tower for sweeping 360-degree views, then explore Viaduct Harbour’s seafood joints and flat whites-with-a-view. Ferry to Waiheke Island for vineyard strolls and golden coves or venture farther to Gr

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Auckland
blocks.text: Don’t stress over planning—experience the best Auckland has to offer, stress-free, with Princess shore excursions. We’ll handle the details so you can relax and soak it all in.

blocks.heading: Zipline Adventure
blocks.text: Waiheke Island isn’t just about wine — it’s where you clip in and soar over forest canopies like a caffeinated falcon. Fly across three ziplines, take a bushwalk through regenerating native forest and learn how this slice of paradise is being protected for the long haul. Bonus: killer views, brag-worthy thrills and the kind of nature that sticks with you. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best Of Auckland: City Drive & Maori Performance at Museum
blocks.text: Explore downtown Auckland’s greatest hits — from heritage buildings to sky-punching towers — then head to the Auckland War Museum for a culture shock (in the best way). The live Māori performance ends with a haka that might shake your spine loose. Big energy, big pride and big-time storytelling in one of New Zealand’s most iconic spots. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Waitomo Glow Worm Grotto
blocks.text: Take a glowing detour into New Zealand’s underground fantasy world, where bioluminescent worms light up ancient cave walls like a silent star show. Drift by boat through limestone halls, visit the acoustically perfect ‘Cathedral,’ then swap darkness for daylight and home-cooked hospitality at Crosshills Farm. It’s three hours each way — but trust us, it’s worth every minute. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Piha Bush & Beach Eco Tour
blocks.text: Slip into the lush side of Auckland with rainforest trails, black-sand beaches and a soundtrack by native birds. This eco-adventure swaps cityscapes for giant ferns, thundering surf and tree-lined paths in the Waitakere Ranges. Snap some wild coastline views, dig your feet into Piha’s iconic volcanic sand and feel like you just walked into another world. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Local Connections: National Maritime Museum & Harbour Cruise
blocks.text: Anchors aweigh for a full-tilt dive into Auckland’s nautical roots. Tour the National Maritime Museum, home to tales of Polynesian navigators and America’s Cup champs. Then cruise the Waitematā Harbour — past yachts, under bridges and into Auckland’s maritime heart. If you're lucky, you might even get to steer the thing. No license required, just a little nerve. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Weta Workshop Unleashed & Auckland Highlights
blocks.text: Monsters, mayhem and movie magic — all served with a side of Auckland skyline. This half-day adventure takes you past beachy bays and into Wētā Workshop Unleashed, where Oscar-winning magic-makers let you peek behind the fantasy curtain. Think trolls, creatures and freaky props galore, with enough interactive weirdness to make your jaw drop and your inner nerd dance. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Discover cruise itineraries sailing from Auckland port
blocks.text: As you begin your Australian cruise, Auckland greets you with a skyline of sailboats, volcanic peaks and a cultural blend that’s equal parts Māori pride and European flair. Sometimes called the ‘City of Sails,’ this harbor-hugging city hums with energy — and stepping aboard here means launching into a voyage full of South Pacific wonders and sun-soaked Australian coastlines.

blocks.heading: Barcelona's Gothic Quarter Walking Tour
blocks.text: Step into history during a tour of the Gothic Quarter, the center of the old city of Barcelona. See the 600-year-old Cathedral of Santa Eulalia and its towering spires and colorful stained glass. Explore the historic palaces that now house the Catalonia government and La Rambla, a mile-long pedestrian street where you can shop until you drop. LEARN MORE

blocks.text: La Sagrada Familia is the most famous Barcelona landmark — even though it’s still under construction and has been for over 100 years! blocks.heading: Things to do in Brisbane, Australia
blocks.text: Brisbane offers a mix of city confidence and down‑to‑earth Aussie charm; expect historic sandstone architecture side by side with sprawling parklands, lively riverfronts and access to some seriously wild nature. You can dig into thriving culture, hit Queensland coastal ports or head out toward the beach‑scene just outside the city.

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Brisbane
blocks.text: Before you hit the open water on your cruise from Brisbane, why not enjoy everything the city (and surrounding areas) have to offer? Pick from curated tours that bring Brisbane’s range of experiences into sharp focus, whether you’re after wildlife encounters, beach time, lush hinterlands or something altogether different.

blocks.heading: Australia Zoo & the Sunshine Coast for Small Groups
blocks.text: Head north to the Sunshine Coast and explore the world‑famous zoo founded by the late Steve Irwin. There, you can roam wildlife shows, feed kangaroos and maybe hold a giant python if you and the snake are both feeling up to it. Then roll into Montville, a mountain village of cafés, craft stores and chilled stroll‑friendly storefronts before the ride back. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary
blocks.text: The world’s first and largest koala sanctuary sits just outside Brisbane and gives you more than 130 koalas to ooh‑and‑ahh over. You’ll also get to feed kangaroos, watch wildlife shows and lean into Aussie critter culture in an appropriately leafy setting. This is one excursion where ‘meeting the locals’ means something entirely different. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Tastes of Tamborine
blocks.text: This tour lifts you into the hinterland of Mt Tamborine, where you begin with a coffee‑plantation visit then wander Gallery Walk’s boutique shops before indulging in a wine‑tasting lunch and finishing with a behind‑the‑scenes gin‑distillery visit. You’ll leave with artisan buys, vineyard views and a gin sample that may or may not spark new ideas for your at‑sea cocktail hour. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Stradbroke Island 4WD Escapade
blocks.text: Board a ferry and then a 4WD vehicle to tackle unsealed roads and sand across North Stradbroke Island. You’ll feel the sea breeze, maybe see wallabies by the dunes and definitely enjoy the bumpy ride. This one’s wild, a bit raw and totally worthy of a brag or two. Just remember the sunscreen. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Gold Coast Beaches: On Your Own
blocks.text: Ride about 1.5 hours to the famed Gold Coast and land at Surfers Paradise. With 26 miles of sand, towering resorts and an always lively atmosphere, you can easily swing the dial back and forth between ‘go big’ and ‘make yourself at home.’ LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Brisbane by Private Vehicle ‑ Car Class Half‑Day (With Driver)
blocks.text: For a more tailored vibe, book a private vehicle (complete with driver) and chart your half‑day through Brisbane’s landmarks at your own pace. You’ll skip the group clusters and enjoy the freedom to pause for an extra coffee or especially photogenic view. Just reserve early — our drivers don’t speed, but availability certainly goes fast. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Things to do in Florida
blocks.text: Florida gives you options. And not just the sunscreen-vs-sunhat kind. When you sail with Princess®, you can kick things off in Fort Lauderdale, Miami or Port Canaveral — each with its own personality and pre-cruise perks. From high-end marinas to neon beach scenes, space rockets to everglade airboats, Florida has too much personality to contain in a single departure port.

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Florida
blocks.text: Whether you’re padding in a day before embarkation or squeezing in some fun post-cruise, Florida serves up excursions that go beyond the usual ‘sun & sand’ routine. Think airboats, astronauts, art deco and alligators — sometimes on the same tour.

blocks.heading: Best of Port Canaveral: Kennedy Space Center (Port Canaveral)
blocks.text: Five hours at Kennedy Space Center is basically a space enthusiast’s fever dream. Explore NASA’s legacy, walk beneath a Saturn V rocket and come face-to-nosecone with the space shuttle Atlantis. You can even try a simulator or catch a 3D IMAX launch. If your idea of a perfect pre-cruise adventure includes goosebumps and gravity talk, this one’s orbiting your name. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Airboat Ride & Flamingo Gardens (Ft. Lauderdale)
blocks.text: Florida’s wild side isn’t just a vibe — it’s a full-throttle airboat ride through the Everglades. Skim across the ‘River of Grass’ at 50 mph while scouting for gators and rare birds, then slow it down at Flamingo Gardens. Here, you’ll hop on a tram to explore lush subtropical grounds, meet native wildlife and, yes, bask in the pink glow of actual flamingos. Available in Ft. Lauderdale. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Intracoastal Waterway by Boat & Las Olas Blvd (Ft. Lauderdale)
blocks.text: Cruise Fort Lauderdale the right way — by paddleboat. Start with a guided tour past the city’s canal-laced neighborhoods, then stroll through the chic shops of Las Olas Boulevard. Next up is a ride on the ‘Carrie B’ paddle-wheeler for a float past jaw-dropping mansions, mega-yachts and everything that puts the makes Fort Lauderdale so ‘extra.’ LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Miami: City Tour (Miami)
blocks.text: This is Miami on fast-forward. A guided drive takes you past the Miami Arena, Brickell Avenue, Coral Gables and Coconut Grove. Explore Little Havana’s Latin rhythm before stepping out in South Beach to see over 800 restored art deco gems. It’s a 3.5-hour sizzle reel of the city’s greatest hits — don’t forget your camera (or your sunscreen). LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Miami and Villa Vizcaya Museum & Gardens (Miami)
blocks.text: First, dip into South Beach for a short stroll through its pastel playground of art deco and ocean views. Then it's off to Coconut Grove for a self-guided tour of the palatial Villa Vizcaya — a Gilded Age mansion turned museum surrounded by 10 acres of Renaissance-inspired gardens. It’s European opulence, served with a little signatire Miami heat. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Miami City Tour & Dolphin Mall Shopping (Miami)
blocks.text: Start on wheels, end on waves. This half-day tour begins with a scenic coach ride through Miami’s best neighborhoods — Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, South Beach — then swaps out pavement for Biscayne Bay. A 90-minute narrated boat tour shows off the skyline, the celebrity homes and maybe even your ship, looking smug at the dock. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Experience the Florida port on your next cruise
blocks.text: Before your ship even leaves the dock, Florida turns on the full-show energy — sunshine, style and just a little happy chaos. Fort Lauderdale gives you yachts and boulevards lined with art, while Port Canaveral offers launch pads, surfers and gators (hopefully not in the same place). And Miami turns the volume all the way up with neon lights, Art Deco curves, late-night cafés and a soundtrack that

blocks.text: Every Princess cruise from Florida begins with a launchpad — and each port brings its own flavor. Fort Lauderdale blends laid-back luxury with natural beauty. Mega-yachts, boutique-lined boulevards, and easy access to the Everglades; the port is close to everything, which means more time soaking it in and less time stuck in traffic. Miami turns the energy up with bold design, nonstop flavor and be

blocks.heading: Things to do in Hong Kong
blocks.text: A city where ancient temples meet modern towers, Hong Kong is a must-see in Asian travel. Set sail from this global hub and step into a world of contrasts, from the quiet serenity of incense-filled shrines to the electric energy of Victoria Harbour. Cruises from Hong Kong with Princess open the door to Asia’s most captivating coastlines, with itineraries that reach Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam and beyon

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Hong Kong
blocks.text: Hong Kong is a city of contrasts, where floating villages drift beneath glass towers and centuries-old temples sit steps away from designer shops. Princess shore excursions bring this dynamic city to life with guided tours that balance iconic sights with immersive experiences. Glide through Victoria Harbour, explore bustling markets and visit sacred monasteries on excursions that add another level

blocks.heading: Walking tour of Old and New Hong Kong
blocks.text: Explore the fascinating contrasts of Hong Kong on foot. Discover historic temples and modern architecture as your guide leads you through winding streets and vibrant neighborhoods. This moderate-paced walking tour offers cultural insight, photo opportunities and a deeper connection to the city’s dynamic evolution. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Hong Kong
blocks.text: Discover the heart of Hong Kong on a full-day journey featuring a scenic harbor cruise, a tram ride to Victoria Peak, a sampan tour through Aberdeen’s floating village and shopping at lively Stanley Market. Enjoy an authentic dim sum lunch and visit a local jewelry workshop to watch skilled artisans at work before returning to the ship. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Lantau Island & Po Lin Monastery
blocks.text: Venture to tranquil Lantau Island to explore Po Lin Monastery and view the majestic Tian Tan Buddha, one of the largest seated bronze Buddhas in the world. This tour combines peaceful landscapes and spiritual landmarks with sweeping views and insight into Hong Kong’s Buddhist heritage, offering a serene contrast to the city's vibrant urban energy. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Macau
blocks.text: Take a high-speed ferry to the former Portuguese colony of Macau, where East meets West in a fascinating blend. Visit the A-Ma Temple, the Ruins of St. Paul and the Museum of Macau before enjoying lunch at a local restaurant. You'll also have time to explore Senado Square and admire the blend of Chinese and European architecture. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Highlights of Hong Kong
blocks.text: See the city's most iconic sights in a single tour. Ride the Peak Tram to Victoria Peak, visit the traditional fishing community in Aberdeen and explore Man Mo Temple. Finish with free time at Stanley Market, where you can shop for local crafts, art and souvenirs in a vibrant, open-air setting. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Hong Kong by vintage tram
blocks.text: Step back in time aboard a vintage tram as you travel through bustling streets lined with colonial architecture and neon signs. This guided tour combines old-world charm with city landmarks, offering a glimpse into both Hong Kong’s past and present. Enjoy views from the Peak and visit historic neighborhoods along the way. LEARN MORE

blocks.text: Sailing from Hong Kong places you at the heart of Asia’s most iconic coastlines. Princess cruise itineraries from this vibrant city reach captivating ports in Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam, Thailand and beyond, all carefully curated for cultural depth and scenic beauty. Choose from round-trip sailings or one-way adventures that let you experience Asia in a way few other journeys can.

blocks.heading: Things to do in Istanbul, Turkey
blocks.text: East meets West in Istanbul, a city that simmers with rich history, bold flavors and an unmistakable energy. Before your Princess® cruise sets sail, spend time exploring its bustling bazaars and architectural marvels that have stood for centuries. From sipping Turkish tea along the Bosphorus to sampling street food in Sultanahmet, Istanbul invites you to slow down and soak in its unmatched charm.

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Istanbul
blocks.text: Step off your ship and straight into the story of Istanbul. Princess' curated excursions take you deep into the heart of this city, where you can marvel at mosque-dotted skylines, cruise the storied Bosphorus or taste centuries of culinary tradition in one bite. Each guided adventure offers something extraordinary, with easy access and expert insight along the way.

blocks.heading: Breakfast Cruise & Blue Mosque Tour
blocks.text: Start your day with a traditional Turkish breakfast aboard a scenic Bosphorus cruise. Afterward, head ashore for a guided visit to the elegant Blue Mosque and a shopping stop at the Grand Bazaar — an experience rich in both flavor and culture. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Istanbul
blocks.text: Experience Istanbul’s most famous landmarks in one enriching tour. This all-in-one journey includes the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Hippodrome, Grand Bazaar and a traditional Turkish lunch. You’ll explore ancient empires and marketplaces — all in a single unforgettable day. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Istanbul City Walls & Spice Bazaar
blocks.text: Tour through Old Istanbul, crossing the Galata Bridge. Your guide will point out the Suleymaniye Mosque, one of the most important mosques of the Ottoman Empire, before you drive along the city walls surrounding the ancient city. You will also pass under the age-old Roman aqueduct on your way to the Spice Market. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Istanbul Highlights & Bosphorus Cruise
blocks.text: Perfectly balanced between land and sea, this excursion includes key landmarks like the Hippodrome and Blue Mosque, followed by a scenic cruise down the Bosphorus Strait. Take in breathtaking views of palaces, mosques and bridges from a new perspective. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: St. Sophia, Blue Mosque & Grand Bazaar
blocks.text: Get a snapshot view of Istanbul in this walking tour. After a scenic drive in your motorcoach from the port, you'll arrive at the Blue Mosque. This 17th-century marvel boasts a multitude of domes and semi-domes and graceful minarets on the exterior, and over 20,000 shimmering blue Iznik tiles in more than 50 different tulip designs, and 216 stained glass windows, on the interior. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Experience Istanbul on your next cruise
blocks.text: Istanbul is a destination that delivers whether you’re beginning your voyage or disembarking after an unforgettable journey. Its mix of ancient wonders and world-class cuisine makes it a highlight on any itinerary. With Princess, you’ll discover the magic of Istanbul as part of a thoughtfully curated Mediterranean itinerary.

blocks.text: Cruises from Istanbul offer a seamless start to your Mediterranean journey. Sail westward toward Greece, Italy and beyond, with plenty of time to explore Istanbul before embarkation. blocks.heading: Things to do in Los Angeles
blocks.text: The City of Angels always hovers between dream and reality. Once a near-forgotten colonial outpost, the pueblo metamorphosed into an agrarian paradise before reinventing itself as a movie colony. blocks.heading: Things to do in Melbourne
blocks.text: Feel the sea breeze on your face and drive down the Great Ocean Road where you can see turquoise waters and the towering Twelve Apostles. Or head up into the clouds and stand 974 feet above the city at the Eureka Skydeck 88 with its 360 viewing platform. Refuel on salt and pepper calamari fresh from the sea smothered in sweet chili sauce.

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Melbourne
blocks.text: Don’t stress over planning — experience the best Melbourne has to offer, stress-free, with Princess shore excursions. We’ll handle the details so you can relax and soak it all in.

blocks.heading: Local Connections: Arcades & Alleyways
blocks.text: Get lost! On purpose in the winding alleyways of Melbourne full of atmospheric arcades (large indoor markets) and colorful graffiti street art. Sip a coffee at an eclectic small cafe and spend a few hours shopping in the trendy boutiques. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Healesville Sanctuary, Yarra Valley & Wine
blocks.text: Let loose your inner wine connoisseur in the Yarra Valley when you head to Rochford Winery and sample the rich shiraz, chardonnay and pinot noir. In addition to relaxing in the vineyards, you’ll also visit an animal sanctuary where you can see the iconic Australian platypus, parrots, kangaroos, wombats and koalas. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Ballarat Wildlife & Sovereign Hill Goldmine Township
blocks.text: Kangaroos, kookaburras and emus, oh my! Is it really a trip to Australia without seeing the one-of-a-kind wildlife? See over 400 Australian species at the Ballarat Wildlife Park where kangaroos run wild before jumping back in time to the 1850s and exploring a gold rush boomtown where you can pan for gold. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Melbourne & Surrounds
blocks.text: Get ready for a day of Aussie highlights! Start by meeting koalas, wombats and platypus up close at Healesville Sanctuary, a haven for native wildlife. Then, channel your inner sommelier with a wine-tasting adventure in the Yarra Valley, sampling world-class pinot noir and Shiraz while soaking in vineyard views. blocks.heading: Cruises from Melbourne
blocks.text: Melbourne is alive with vibrant laneways, legendary coffee and a culture that pulses with energy. This is your gateway to adventure with Princess Cruises®, sailing to the South Pacific, New Zealand and beyond!

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Miami
blocks.text: These curated adventures hit Miami’s big beats and backroads. Whether you want to ride an airboat, shop till your suitcase begs for mercy or walk through a palace in the tropics, there’s something here that’ll stick with you.

blocks.heading: Best of Miami: By Land & Sea
blocks.text: Split your day between wheels and water. Start with a scenic drive through the city, from historic neighborhoods to gleaming financial districts. Then head to Bayside Marketplace and board a sightseeing boat for a 90-minute tour of Biscayne Bay. You’ll cruise past the Port of Miami before you return to the pier feeling like you’ve seen it all. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Miami: City Tour
blocks.text: Get a sweeping view of Miami’s hits on this 3.5-hour city tour. Drive through downtown past the Miami Arena and Bayside Marketplace before cruising Brickell Avenue into Coconut Grove. Explore Coral Gables and its Mediterranean-style architecture, then take in the sights and sounds of Little Havana. Cap it off with a guided walk through South Beach’s Art Deco District for some history in pastel. LE

blocks.heading: Miami and Villa Vizcaya Museum & Gardens
blocks.text: Start your half-day with a drive through South Beach and a stroll along Ocean Avenue’s candy-colored architecture. Then head for Coconut Grove and the Vizcaya Museum, where European design meets subtropical landscaping. Enjoy a self-guided audio tour through rooms filled with antiques and gardens designed to outclass Versailles. It’s elegance, Miami-style. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Scenic Drive & Dolphin Mall Shopping Spree
blocks.text: See the city highlights first, then shop like you mean it. After driving past South Beach, Little Havana and Coral Gables, you’ll hit Dolphin Mall: a 1.4 million square foot retail paradise. Spend four hours browsing boutiques, sampling snacks and trying on outfits you’ll hope you’ve got space in your luggage for. Then return to the coach for the drive back. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Everglades Airboat Adventure
blocks.text: Head out to the 'Glades, where 1.5 million acres of subtropical wilderness are yours to experience. Climb into an airboat and skim across the shallow water at speeds up to 50 mph. This national park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site for good reason, with sawgrass prairies, mangrove swamps and enough plant and animal life to fill a biology textbook. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Miami with Latin Lunch
blocks.text: This full-day deep dive mixes Miami’s urban energy with the natural wonders of the Everglades. Start with an airboat ride where crocodiles and alligators share turf. Then sit down to a Cuban-style lunch that tastes like a celebration. blocks.heading: Things to do in Perth (Fremantle)
blocks.text: Start your Princess® adventure in Perth (Fremantle), where the charm of historic streets meets a contemporary Australian lifestyle. Wander streets lined with artisan markets, indulge in fresh seafood along the coast and soak up the energy of this iconic port city. With its unique blend of culture, history and coastal beauty, Fremantle is the perfect gateway to explore destinations both near and fa

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Perth (Fremantle)
blocks.text: Don’t stress over planning — experience the best Perth (Fremantle) has to offer, stress-free, with Princess shore excursions. We’ll handle the details so you can relax and soak it all in. Not sure where to start? Check out these popular excursions:

blocks.heading: Essence of Western Australia
blocks.text: Combine city highlights and back‑country adventure in one day: drive through Perth skylines, stop at Kings Park for views, visit a Swan Valley winery for wine tasting and lunch, and then float down the Swan River on a cruise unlike any other. Finally, wrap up with a motorcoach ride through Fremantle’s heritage quarter. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Best of Perth & Perth (Fremantle)
blocks.text: Hop aboard a motorcoach from Fremantle pier then drive through Beach Road and the Esplanade en route to Perth’s city centre. Enjoy free time to explore the Perth Mint or relax with coffee at a café, then cruise the Swan River from Barrack Street Jetty back to Fremantle with commentary on riverside homes and the famed ‘Millionaire’s Row.’ LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Caversham Wildlife Park & River Cruise
blocks.text: Head through the lush Swan Valley viticulture region to Caversham Wildlife Park where you’ll have the chance to meet koalas and kangaroos in a relaxed bush‑setting. Then board a 75‑minute air‑conditioned boat down the Swan River, spot riverside mansions and birdlife, before returning by motorcoach to Fremantle. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: West Coast Wineries
blocks.text: Enjoy a scenic drive into the Swan Valley — Western Australia’s oldest wine region — and visit two boutique estates for guided tastings led by the winemakers themselves. Explore vineyards, sample cool‑climate varietals, shop for gourmet souvenirs and soak in some countryside charm under bright blue skies (provided it’s not cloudy, of course). LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Local Connections: Historic Perth (Fremantle) and the America's Cup
blocks.text: Explore Fremantle’s 19th‑century limestone buildings, visit the Round House and the 1855 Fremantle Prison and then continue to the WA Maritime Museum to see the yacht that claimed the 1983 America’s Cup. Oh, and did we mention that John Longley, a crew member from that historic victory, will share firsthand stories from the race? That’s some serious immersion. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Dolphins & Sea Lions, Oh My!
blocks.text: Journey to Rockingham and board a boat out to Penguin Island and the Shoalwater Islands Marine Park. Get up close to wild dolphins, sea lion colonies and pelicans, stroll sandy beaches and breathe in open‑sea freedom. It’s a who’s who of the kinds of animals you’d hope to meet when exploring the coastlines of the Southern Hemisphere. LEARN MORE

blocks.text: Set sail from Perth (Fremantle) with Princess Cruises and explore some of the most memorable destinations across the Indian Ocean, Australia and beyond. blocks.heading: Things to do in Quebec City

blocks.heading: Walking Tour of Historic Québec
blocks.text: Go back in time as you enjoy the rich history of Quebec City with a guided walking tour through its storied Upper and Lower Towns, featuring beautifully restored buildings and significant landmarks. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Grand Exploration of Québec & Lunch
blocks.text: Immerse yourself in Quebec City's rich heritage with a full-day tour that includes visits to Montmorency Falls—standing 272 feet tall—and the historic Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré shrine. Then enjoy a complimentary French-Canadian lunch, offering a taste of the region's culinary delights. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Panoramic UNESCO Historic Sites
blocks.text: Experience a narrated drive through Quebec City's most significant historic sites, including the famed Château Frontenac and the charming Place Royale. This excursion offers a broad overview of the city's UNESCO-listed treasures. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Montmorency Falls & Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré
blocks.text: Witness the breathtaking Montmorency Falls, standing 90 feet higher than Niagara Falls, and visit the serene Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré shrine, a pilgrimage site attracting visitors worldwide. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Rendez-Vous at Wendake Cultural Village
blocks.text: Delve into the heritage of the Huron-Wendat Nation at the Wendake Amerindian Village. Explore traditional longhouses, learn about ancestral customs and experience the vibrant culture of the First Nations people. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: A Stroll Through Québec City & High Tea at Château Frontenac
blocks.text: Enjoy a guided tour through Quebec City's historic streets, culminating in a luxurious high tea at the iconic Château Frontenac — it’s just a taste of the refined elegance the city has to offer. LEARN MORE

blocks.heading: Shore excursions to explore in Ravenna
blocks.text: The beauty of Ravenna lies in its depth—each plaza, each basilica, each regional hamlet holds layers of story. Princess shore excursions pair expert local guides with seamless logistics so you can experience Ravenna's treasures without the logistical weight. You'll return to your ship with a genuine understanding of the art, history, and flavors that have shaped this corner of Italy for two millen

blocks.heading: Faenza & Brisighella
blocks.text: Discover two small towns where traditional crafts thrive. Faenza houses the International Museum of Ceramics alongside contemporary artisans still practicing their craft. Brisighella clings to a hilltop with rambling ivy and narrow passageways—authentic Italy away from cruise ship routes, where locals far outnumber tourists. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Ravenna & The Republic of San Marino
blocks.text: Explore two strikingly different worlds in one excursion. Begin with the Basilica di San Vitale, where Byzantine mosaics of Emperor Justinian and Empress Theodora captivate with intricate detail. Then ascend to San Marino, a medieval microstate perched on a ridge top, where narrow alleys, artisan ceramics, and panoramic views reward exploration. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Best of Ravenna, Basilica di San Vitale & Bologna
blocks.text: Pair Ravenna's Byzantine art with Bologna's gastronomic authority. Your guide explains the mosaics' political symbolism in the Basilica di San Vitale, then journey to Bologna's covered arcades where handmade pasta, aged vinegars, and cured meats define Italian cuisine. Absorb Renaissance architecture in the Piazza Maggiore or simply observe the rhythm of Italian daily life. VIEW EXCURSION

blocks.heading: Ravenna, Basilica di San Vitale & Dante's Tomb
blocks.text: For those drawn to literary history, this excursion connects Italy's greatest poet to the city that gave him his final resting place. Visit the modest, dignified tomb where Dante Alighieri has rested since 1321, then step into the Basilica di San Vitale to witness the artistic pinnacle of Byzantine Italy. The combination reveals how Ravenna remained a beacon of sophisticated culture even as its po

blocks.heading: Comacchio Lagoon & Wine Tasting
blocks.text: Experience wetlands entirely different from Ravenna's art-filled core. Travel by traditional flat-bottomed boat through canals, observing herons and glimpsing centuries-old fishing traditions. Visit a working winery in the Po River delta, where soil and microclimate produce distinctive wines—crisp whites that pair perfectly with the region's seafood. VIEW EXCURSIONS

blocks.heading: The Region's Queens: Bologna & Ferrara
blocks.text: Journey beyond Ravenna to explore two Emilia-Romagna powerhouses that shaped Renaissance Italy. Bologna dazzles with its terracotta rooftops, porticoed streets, and the gravitational pull of food culture—this is where modern Italian cooking was codified.
